description: List every API key on your account, newest first, including revoked ones (isActive false, revokedAt set). Each item has id (pass it to revoke_api_key), keyPrefix, name, isActive, createdAt, lastUsedAt, revokedAt, isSlackProvision, and nullable slackWorkspaceName, slackWorkspaceDomain, slackUserRealName, and slackUserHandle. Never returns the raw key value. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY to be set.
name: list_api_keys
title: List API keys
